This can help them communicate their feelings and concerns without feeling overwhelmed or defensive. 3. **Focus on the community gathering**: Emphasize the importance of the community gathering and how their presence would benefit everyone. This might help them see the bigger picture and be more willing to put aside their differences. 4. **Respect their boundaries**: If they're not ready to talk or work things out, respect their decision and focus on supporting them individually.
